name: brightterm
description: BrightTerm - SSH / Serial / Telnet terminal with vault, SFTP and image paste
author: Dany Kim

scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:dir: npm run notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:mac:dir: npm run notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.dist:mac:signed: npm run notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac -c electron-builder.signed.yml
